name: Tendou Kazuma
source: The protagonist, who already treats his misfortunes as a part of his daily life, it has been 38 times that he had been kidnapped, so his younger sister [url=/c59132]Ichika[/url] and maid [url=/c59134]Kiko[/url] are forbade him from leaving the house. Somehow, he met [url=/c59131]Shiro[/url] who is a [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zashiki-warashi]zashikiwarashi[/url].
